title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
description: Creamy noodles, chicken, peas, and a crunchy top.
substitutions: Use cooked turkey instead of chicken.
Skip breadcrumbs if you want it extra simple.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil noodles until just tender and drain.
Mix noodles, chicken, soup, milk, peas, and 1/2 cup cheddar.
Spread into a greased 9x13-inch dish. Top with remaining cheese and optional breadcrumbs.
Bake 25–30 minutes until bubbling and golden at the edges.

title: Stuffed Pepper Skillet
description: All the flavor of stuffed peppers without stuffing anything.

steps.text: Brown the ground meat with peppers and onion in a large skillet.
Stir in rice, diced tomatoes with juice, broth, and Italian seasoning.
Cover and simmer 18–20 minutes, stirring once, until rice is tender.
Sprinkle with cheese if using; cover 2 minutes to melt.

title: White Bean Tomato Soup
description: A fast pantry soup with white beans, tomatoes, and Italian seasoning.

ingredients.item: white beans, drained and rinsed, 15 oz each

steps.text: Put beans, tomatoes, broth, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder in a pot.
Bring to a simmer and cook 15–20 minutes.
Stir in spinach for the final 2 minutes if using. Taste and season.

title: Easy Corn Potato Chowder
description: Creamy potato and corn soup made with everyday ingredients.
substitutions: Add diced ham if you have leftovers.

steps.text: Simmer potatoes, onion, corn, broth, and salt for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
In a small bowl whisk milk with flour until smooth.
Stir milk mixture and butter into the soup. Simmer 5–8 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened.
